title: Parameter symmetries determine representational geometry in overparameterized nonlinear networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.39078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representations are routinely used across machine learning, psychology, and neuroscience to draw inferences about the computations of biological and artificial systems. Such inferences presume a meaningful link between representational geometry and the computation being performed. For artificial neural networks, however, the extent to which function constrains representation remains unclear. One key obstacle is that these networks admit parameter symmetries: changes in parameterization that preserve function exactly while reshaping representational geometry. Here, we show that a broad class of parameter symmetries acts on representations through just three primitive feature transformations: addition, duplication, and scaling. translated_title: 参数对称性决定过参数化非线性网络中的表征几何
translated_abstract: 表征在机器学习、心理学和神经科学领域被广泛使用，用以推断生物系统和人工系统的计算过程。这类推断预设了表征几何与所执行计算之间存在有意义的联系。然而，对于人工神经网络而言，函数在多大程度上约束表征仍不清楚。一个关键障碍在于这些网络容许参数对称性的存在：即在完全保持函数不变的同时重塑表征几何的参数化改变。在本文中，我们证明了一类广泛的参数对称性仅通过三种基本的特征变换作用于表征：加法、复制和缩放。这种特征层面的刻画得出了表征几何的闭式分解，将其分解为本质成分与辅助成分，从而精确阐明了表征几何中的退化如何增长……
tldr: 该论文揭示参数对称性仅通过加法、复制和缩放三种基本特征变换重塑表征几何，并据此给出表征几何的闭式分解，将函数决定的本质成分与函数无关的辅助成分精确区分开来。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a broad class of parameter symmetries reshapes representational geometry through just three primitive feature transformations—addition, duplication, and scaling—yielding a closed-form decomposition of representational geometry into function-determined essential components and function-irrelevant auxiliary components.
